name: swing-feel
description: Looks and sound of a crop in the hand: model, grip, whoosh, slap, bleed

steps.message: Is the crop held by the handle, pointing forward, with its own texture (not a club)? Is the inventory icon a tilted crop?
Swing at the boar. Do you hear a whoosh on the swing and ONE slap on the hit, loud and instant?
Does the boar bleed (red ticks) for about five seconds after a hit, and not stack on a second hit?
